findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The triple sink was tested and recorded at 50ppm at the start of the inspection. PIC was made aware and emptied the triple sink and refilled it and created a new sanitizer solution. The new solution was tested and recorded at 100ppm chlorine. Ensure the triple sink is tested and changed at a frequency necessary to maintain the sanitizer’s efficacy. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.13: The coving near the triple sink near the roaster is observed to have come unattached from the wall. Ensure repairs are made to the coving to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED.
